patches.summary: OpenCode runtime def speaks v2 dialect: no --dir (PWD env + cwd), no --pure, session export, -m provider/model#variant, skip-permissions passed through
Reasoning variants from one-shot opencode serve --stdio + GET /api/model; fallback to plain id list, never break listing
MCP injection emits v2 ONLY: {mcp:{servers:{...}}}, disabled instead of enabled (decision: v2-only, 2026-11-05)
Permission grants emit v2 ONLY: permissions ordered ruleset [{action,resource,effect}], last-match-wins, deny last
Backport upstream PR #8927: signed-out sessions are share-free, project delete works fully local (issue #8926)
Rewrite better-sqlite3 imports to runtime/db/better-sqlite3-shim.ts (bun:sqlite adapter); delete better-sqlite3 dependency + its rebuild stage
patches.supersededBy: never (core radical decision) — shrinks if upstream adopts bun:sqlite

patches.summary: Replace services/node-pty.ts loader with runtime/pty/bun-terminal.ts (Bun.spawn + Bun.Terminal); delete node-pty dependency
Hot child_process paths (agent runtimes first) use runtime/proc/bun-spawn.ts (Bun.spawn, PWD-env contract)
patches.supersededBy: shrinks file-by-file as call sites migrate

patches.summary: Remove undici usage; connection test uses Bun native fetch. Parent's undici-socks5 patch has NO counterpart here
Smoke/static-health probe via Bun.serve (runtime/http/bun-serve.ts). Full Express re-plumb is optional and must not gate R1-R4

Vela team/cloud integration PARKED in the Bun build (Hadi, 2026-11-06): upstream's external team CLI (daemon shells out via src/integrations/vela-command.ts; collab adapters, AMR runtime binary, login/billing/team-projects/share) is not carried by odbun's local/single-user web scope. Its 73 test suites are excluded on BOTH harnesses via apps/daemon/tests/parked-features.json (wired in apps/daemon/vitest.config.ts); production code stays in tree, dormant and untouched — Vela is rooted in 122 src files, so removal was rejected in favour of parking. Census and borderline calls: port/TEST-SUITES.md §8
patches.supersededBy: a future decision to carry team features
